name: EaseonSS - PumpkinCarver
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Teron
description:
Hold shears or an axe in one hand and a pumpkin in the other to carve it instantly.
You can also carve placed pumpkins with an axe, just like using shears in vanilla.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-26 (cdf45c68) (19 classes, 20 members). Not run yet.
